The parse puts all 126 rows into ONE event (places 1..66 then 1..60 repeat), so the checker mixes the two fields. It should be two events: Boys 3.06 Mile Run CC Varsity, Large School (AB-, 66 rows) and Small School (CD-, 60 rows), each with its own team_rankings (AB: John Bapst 63, Hampden 76, Ellsworth 76, Caribou 86, MDI 116, Old Town 131, Brewer 141, Presque Isle 191, Bangor 221, Hermon 310; CD: Central 69, Orono 77, Sumner 85, Lee 89, Mattanawcook 123, Schenck 152, GSA 152, Foxcroft 184, PCHS 204). Rows themselves match the source. The 'AB-'/'CD-' prefix is the class tag and the parser should strip it into division. School finding: 'AB-Bucksport' (Tommy Cyr, place 43, one runner, no points) resolved to '?' -> it is Bucksport (me-hs-bucksport), the prefix just blocks the match; also the same race/athletes are in pvc04bv.txt (overall scoring, 1-decimal times), so these two files double-list the 126 athletes.

xc_course/scarborough.notes: Alias 'scarborough' -> Smiling Hill Farm: Scarborough's home meets are headed 'SMILING HILL FARM' in 2004, 2006-2010, 2012, 2013, 2016, 2017 (and the 2018 middle-school meet); factors 1.021 vs 1.025. Unverified (no venue in header): 2003, 2005, 2011, 2015, 2019, 2020, 2022, 2023, 2024; the 2023-24 'Scarborough HS XC Home Meet' files may be at the Athletic Complex (2020/2025/2026 headers) - no evidence either way.

xc_course/scarborough athletic complex.notes: Keep as its own course: headers name the Athletic Complex (2020 SMAA, 2025, 2026 MileSplit); different from Smiling Hill Farm. When the high school moved there is not dated by any source, so no change recorded.

xc_course/schenck.notes: Keep: Wolverine Invitational at Schenck HS (sub5 2009/XC/WolverineInvitational 'at Schenck High School'). Factor-only pair with Skowhegan is a different place: distinct.

xc_course/searsport.notes: Keep: Searsport HS course (headers 'Searsport Viking Invitational' 2007, 'Searsport High School' 2019). The 2.61 mi (2007-09) and 5K (2016-20) nodes differ by printed distance and factor ratio 0.87 tracks the distance ratio 0.84; no source dates a layout change, so none recorded. Distinct from Sumner and Washington Academy.

xc_course/skowhegan.notes: Keep: all headers Skowhegan HS ('Skowhegan HS' 2015, 2017, 2020). The 2015 node is labelled '3 Mile Run CC' (2 races, 12% off 5K) - a distance label/odd file, not a new course. Distinct from Schenck.

xc_course/smiling hill.notes: Keep as the course; Scarborough and Waynflete/Westbrook 2020-22 meets headed Smiling Hill are folded here via the alias and corrections.

xc_course/south portland.notes: Keep: changes 2015 and 2023 already recorded (2.68 mi new course 2015; Wainwright Sports Complex 2023 header). The 2.92 mi 2014 node is one middle-school Paul Brogan Invitational race - label only.

xc_course/spruce mountain.notes: Keep: 'Jay, Maine/ME' headers 2019-2024 and 'Spruce Mtn' are one place (aliases exist). The 2018-19 vs 2020+ era split (1.025 vs 1.082) has no source for a layout change; automatic eras stand.

xc_course/st dominics.notes: Keep: St. Dominic Academy's course (MileSplit 'St Dominic's XC Course' 2016-2024; sub5 2017 'ST DOM'S XC MEET ... ST DOMINIC HS'); 'St. Doms' aliased. Distinct from Waynflete.

xc_course/st josephs.notes: Keep: St. Joseph's College (Standish/Windham), headers 'St. Joseph's College, Windham, ME' 2011, MileSplit 'St. Joe's College XC Course' 2012-2016; spellings fold. Distinct from Sacopee Valley.

xc_course/sumner.notes: Keep; record change 2016: Seacoast Invitational at Sumner HS printed '2.55 miles' in 2015 and '3.05 miles' in 2016-2017 (same venue, Sullivan). The 2.98 mi 2012 single race is a printed distance only.

xc_course/sunset ridge.notes: Keep: Westbrook HS home meets 2016-17 headed 'Sunset Ridge Golf Course' (2.95 mi in 2016). 2.92 mi vs 5K nodes are printed distances. Not merged with Westbrook (MS XC Course) or Sanford: no evidence they share a layout.

xc_course/telstar.notes: Keep: Telstar HS course in Bethel, 9 races 2010-2022, Telstar XC course aliased.

xc_course/thornton.notes: Keep: Thornton Academy course. The 2.98 mi 2024 node is one 2024 TA-BOYS file (1.5 mile middle-school event, 7% off) - noise, not a new course. Distinct from Westbrook and Sacopee Valley.

xc_course/traip.notes: Keep: already aliased with Fort Foster/Kittery. Traip 2.8 mi (2016, header '2.8 MILES ... FOSTER') is the same Fort Foster course, label only. Distinct from Wells and York (different home venues).

xc_course/twin brook.notes: Keep one course (Greely/Cumberland home); aliases point to the table's display name 'Twin Brook Recreation Area' (the older 'Twin Brook (Cumberland)' target does not match the table). 2005 WMC files indexed 'Cumberland' carry header 'Twin Brooks'.

xc_course/um augusta.notes: Keep: UMA (Augusta), MVC/KVAC host; headers 'UMA - AUGUSTA, ME', 'UMA Course' all one place.

xc_course/um presque isle.notes: Alias 'umpi' -> Presque Isle: the Presque Isle Invitational 2004 is headed 'at UMPI', 2006 Aroostook League meet hosted by PIHS is headed 'UMPI', 2018 PVC (index UMPI) is headed 'Presque Isle', MileSplit calls it 'University of Maine Presque Isle XC course' (already aliased to Presque Isle). Same venue.

xc_course/washburn.notes: Keep: Washburn HS course. The 2.8 mi node is a 'Short Course - 2.8 miles' day (sub5 2016/XC/washburn_oct12) and 2.86 mi 2011-14 a printed distance; no layout change dated, none recorded.

xc_course/washington.notes: Keep: single race, 'Washington Academy XC Meet - 9/15/2017' at Washington Academy (East Machias). Distinct from Searsport and Sumner.

xc_course/waterville.notes: Alias not added. 2003 meet was 'at Colby College'; Waterville 2017-21 JH/HS meets carry no header venue. Factor 1.047 vs Quarry Road 1.076 (2.8% apart) supports but cannot prove a merge, and no source dates the move to Quarry Road before 2018; automatic eras stand. The 2024 files are corrected to Quarry Road.

xc_course/waynflete.notes: Corrected: 2020 waynboys/wayngirls headers say 'WAYNFLETE/ST DOMS/NYA - 10/1/2020 / SMILING HILL', so they join Smiling Hill Farm; the Waynflete course disappears. No other Waynflete home evidence. Distinct from Royal River, Sacopee Valley, St. Dominic's.

xc_course/wells.notes: Keep: Wells HS course ('Boys Meet at Wells High School 2.9 miles' 2008; 'Wells High School Home Meet' 2011-12, 2023). The 2012 era boundary (0.947 vs 1.054) is automatic; no header dates a layout change, so none recorded. Distinct from Traip and York.

xc_course/westbrook.notes: Keep: Westbrook MS XC Course (MileSplit) and Westbrook index rows. 2021 Results-F1-10 and 2022 WEST-MS are corrected to Smiling Hill Farm (headers); 2015 and 2016-17 were already handled. No evidence the Westbrook MS course equals Sunset Ridge or Thornton: distinct.

xc_course/windham.notes: Pair with 'windham track': merge (see below). Windham itself is one course (Windham HS XC course; headers/index 2005-2026 all Windham), eras not touched.

xc_course/windham track.notes: Alias to Windham. Only meet is MileSplit 'Windham - Deer/Kenn/No' 2022-09-26 (me.milesplit.com/meets/498251), listing venue 'Windham, ME', host Windham HS, Windham has no other 2022 XC race; 'Track' is the MileSplit venue label. Factors 1.079 (SE 0.018) vs 1.041 (SE 0.008) agree within 3.8%. Only one meet is under this name, so the alias cannot catch another place.

xc_course/yarmouth.notes: Single course: every header says Pratt's Brook Park, Yarmouth (2008, 2010, 2011, 2016-2019, 2020 'PRATTS BROOK'; 2012 file 'PRATTS BROOK 2.95 Miles'). The 'Yarmouth (2.92 mi)' label is only the 2012 race (yarmouth_sept14) whose header prints 2.95 mi instead of 3.1/5K; no evidence of a layout change (2010 prints 3.15 mi, 2011 5KM, back at 5K), one race at 0.993 vs 1.042, 4.9% apart, so a distance-label/measurement difference. No alias possible (same venue string); orchestrator may fold the 2012 distance label into 5K. 'Royal River Park' (NYA) is a different park and stays separate.

xc_course/york.notes: Venue is York HS campus course (headers: 'York High Campus' 2007, 'YHS campus' 2014-16, 'YHS course' 2017-18). Corrections: 2012/XC/yorkboys_oct4 is Fort Foster (header), 2013 traip_sept27 and 2012 york_sept13 already corrected; those were what pulled the 2.92/2.98 labels apart. Remaining 2.92 label = 2007-2010 headers printing 2.9 mi vs 3.0 mi elsewhere on the same campus course: a measurement/rounding difference, no layout evidence. From 2022 headers print 3.1 mi and factor is 1.055: recorded as a change in 2022.
